title: Velo Client 1.2.5: Pack Library, one-click Repair, and a launcher that updates itself properly
summary: Browse and install resource packs right in the game, fix a broken install with one button, import from OneClient with your worlds - plus +17% FPS on Vulkan and an updater that no longer gives up.

blocks.text: **Velo Client 1.2.5** is about the things that should just work: getting packs, fixing a broken install, moving over from another client and updating - plus another big FPS step on Vulkan.

blocks.caption: Resource Packs > Get packs: every Modrinth resource pack for your version, right in the game.

items: Search and sort by relevance, downloads or newest
**Install** puts the pack straight into your list - it shows up under Available right away
Packs made for another version are installed too (textures carry over)

blocks.caption: Settings > Updates & system > Repair - also right in the crash window.

blocks.text: Something broken and no idea why? **Repair** puts the current Velo mod back into every profile, clears Fabric's cache and downloads the current build again. **Repair everything** also reinstalls the launcher. Your worlds, settings and other mods stay exactly as they are.

items: **+17% FPS** in our benchmark scene on 26.2 (2690 → 3160 FPS), 1% lows up too
Minecraft drew two invisible full-screen passes every frame - the entity-outline layer with nothing glowing and the vignette in daylight. Velo skips them when they can't change a pixel.
**Import from OneClient** - mods, worlds, settings, servers and configs
Imports bring your **worlds** by default (Lunar imports found none before)
CurseForge folders on other drives are found, mod and pack pictures appear right after importing
Broken downloads continue where they stopped and retry by themselves
On Windows the update installs **without clicking through the installer** and the launcher starts again on its own
Live progress with speed and time left - and a log for every step (updates/update.log)
The window fits small and scaled screens: no more buttons under the taskbar
Black/white screen on 1.21.x after updating to 1.2.2
Crash with old Lunar library copies (the Doctor turns them off)
Removing a mod failed silently - now it says why (usually the game is still running)
Mod search results could mix when typing fast

blocks.text: The launcher updates itself - just open it. New download: velo-client.com/download
